scope.summary: Implement the FurStrandMaterial, authority storage, capability hooks, and validation foundation consumed by MT-774's in-WP shared groom/fur authoring, simulation, rendering, and export implementation.
acceptance_criteria: FurStrandMaterial struct is defined in tailor-solver/src/texture.rs with fields: strand_density_per_cm2 f32, strand_length_cm f32, strand_direction_deg f32, and seam_aware bool

The tailor_fur_strands migration and versioned authority contract are complete and expose stable garment/material bindings for MT-774; runtime render/simulation ownership remains in MT-774 rather than a duplicate foundation path.

The `fur-strands` Cargo feature is a bounded compile/capability boundary; professional profiles that require TCAP-MD26-FUR-FIBER-DOWN fail closed if it is unavailable and MT-774 owns qualification of the enabled route.

FUR_STRAND_UNAVAILABLE is a typed blocking finding for required professional profiles and an advisory only for an explicitly accepted reduced profile; no placeholder or future-WP deferral may satisfy the capability row.
The foundation schema, storage, capability discovery, event ids, and UserManual link are consumed unchanged by MT-774 and reject incompatible versions rather than silently dropping strands.
proof_targets: cargo build -p tailor-solver (without fur-strands feature) succeeds with no fur rendering code compiled in
scope.risk_if_missed: Without this foundation, fur/hair material on garments (fur-collar coats, fuzzy sweaters) has no authoritative storage or capability path, forcing MT-774 to invent incompatible schema and bindings while implementing the required in-WP groom lane.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-UI scope: behavior remains observable through typed Tailor state, receipts, captures, diagnostics, and TraceProjection; GUI projection is verified by the owning native-shell MT.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > UVs, graphics, and materials

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

required_changes_before_execution: Added gui_obligation, user_manual_obligation, and HBR-INT-009 tier obligations from the current MT template without removing original scope.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
